text: Does Zoho ERP do job costing? Not by that name.
It costs each manufacturing order: components, plus operations.
Cost templates price each operation: each line a fixed amount or an hourly rate.
Job card time turns the hourly lines into labour cost.
A Cost Overview shows estimated against actual on a completed order.
The catch: no version for the US, UK, Australia or New Zealand. And it is not in Zoho One.
Other Zoho apps can't cost a production job with material and labour together.
ZMOS costs the job itself: material issued, less returns, plus hours at your rate.
